evidence.curator_note: Shared first step of the 'OE+.' block (identical in IMS8-EQ8.53a and IMS8-EQ8.54): radical-site alpha-cleavage of the n-ionized exocyclic substituent Y opens the carbocycle to the distonic ion Y+=CH-CH2-...-CH2. . Book draws 2 arc(s) on the left-hand cyclic structure; moves <1,2> are drawn (fishhook from the '+.' on Y into the forming Y=C pi bond, fishhook from the ring C-C bond into that same pi bond) and move <3> is an implicit homolysis hook required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). INSTANTIATION (B/F): Y = OH, six-membered carbocycle = cyclohexanol molecular ion C6H12O+. m/z 100.0883, charge and odd electron localised on oxygen as printed; the OH hydrogen is the curator's minimal completion of the book's bare 'Y'.

ALTERNATIVE branch of Eq 8.53: the page prints 'or' and a second reaction arrow labelled 'alpha, -C2H4' leaving the SAME ring-opened distonic ion, drawn as a separate route to the same final ion, which is why it is recorded separately from IMS8-EQ8.53a. Textbook radical-site alpha-cleavage at the tail: the terminal radical forms a C=C pi bond with its neighbour, the next C-C sigma bond breaks and neutral ethylene is expelled, leaving the radical two carbons further along the chain. Book draws 0 arc(s) for this step - only the labelled reaction arrow and the shortened 'bucket' product - so moves <1,2,3> are all curator-supplied and reproduce the standard three-fishhook alpha-cleavage exactly (move 3 is the homolysis hook onto the new radical carbon).

Second half of the 'or' branch: the arrow is labelled 'alpha, -CnH2n' and ends at the same .CH2-CH=Y+ ion that the direct branch (IMS8-EQ8.53a) reaches. Book draws 0 arc(s) here; moves <1,2,3> are curator-supplied standard alpha-cleavage fishhooks (move 3 being the homolysis hook that leaves the odd electron on the carbon alpha to Y+=CH). AMBIGUITY DISCLOSED: the book writes the neutral only as the formula 'CnH2n', which fits both an alkene and a cycloalkane; it is encoded here as the alkene produced by a plain radical-site alpha-cleavage (n = 2 for the cyclohexanol instantiation, i.e. a second ethylene), the reading that keeps this step the same reaction type as the preceding '-C2H4' arrow. If instead the intended neutral is the carbocycle of the direct branch, the step is the homolytic ring closure encoded in IMS8-EQ8.53a. For the instantiation the intermediate is C4H8O+. m/z 72.0570 and the final ion C2H4O+. m/z 44.0257.

CROSS-LINK CHECKED - NO MATCHING RULE. rule_index.json 'by_equation' has no entry for 8.53. IMS_bookCover.py's hTransition_saturated_2 ('# siehe 8.53') and hTransition_saturated_2_alpha ('RE-AUTHORED from Gl. 8.53 (book p. 179 ...)') cite this equation but do not encode it: both require the onium to be SINGLE-bonded to a saturated carbon next to the radical, and the alpha rule cleaves the C-Y bond expelling [_A+.] as the ion while keeping the carbons neutral - the opposite partition to the one drawn here (Y stays in the ion, the carbons leave as neutral CnH2n). RDKit substructure tests of both left-hand patterns against the instantiated ring-opened ion return 0 matches. Logged as a mismatch, not as support. MS CONTEXT: the reacting species is the odd-electron molecular ion, so adduct '[M]+.'; the page prints no electron energy (70 eV is the book's standing EI condition, not a datum on this page). PEAK: 44.0257 is COMPUTED from the curator's cyclohexanol instantiation; the page prints no m/z and no intensity, hence status 'inferred', detected=false, relative_intensity omitted.
